newsitem.title: JAPAN: Koa Oil's Osaka topper to be shut May 17 - Jun 21.
newsitem.headline: Koa Oil's Osaka topper to be shut May 17 - Jun 21.

text.p: Koa Oil Co Ltd said on Monday it would close its 104,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) primary distillation unit at its Osaka refinery from May 17 to June 21 for routine maintenance checks.

Other facilities in the complex, which include a 55,000 bpd vacuum distillation unit, a 25,000 bpd catalytic cracker, a 8,000 bpd alkylation unit, a 11,000 bpd catalytic reformer, a 15,000 bpd naphtha desulphuriser, a 25,000 bpd kerosene and gas oil desulphuriser, and a 15,000 bpd indirect desulphuriser, will also be closed in turn for checks from May 8, a refinery official said. This turnarounds will end on July 2, he said.
Koa Oil's 127,000 bpd Marifu refinery, which underwent a turnaround in 1996, will not be closed for checks this year.
Koa Oil is owned 50 percent by Caltex Petroleum Corp, a joint venture between U.S. oil majors Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
